title: The Wrong Smile
author: Ulyana Villalobos
blurb: Ivo Pemberton, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
